messages:
zoe: Heads-up: bringing up RareBird-3B-v1 from FeatherAI for a customer POC. They asked for an offline container with quantized weights.
henry: License?
zoe: Snippet: FeatherAI Model License v1.0 -- Section 2 NC only; Section 4 no redistribution of weights without written consent; derivative quantized binaries = derivative works; Section 7 attribution required.
legal-bot: Short: non-commercial + redistribution prohibition. We cannot ship quantized checkpoints to paying customers unless FeatherAI provides a written commercial sublicense.
henry: Alternatives: (a) ask for sublicense, (b) offer managed Private where we run the model (no weight handoff), or (c) BYOW runtime where customer supplies weights and attests license.
zoe: Customer wants air-gapped deliverable. I'll ping FeatherAI for sublicense wording and whether BYOW is acceptable. Will CC Legal. ops-bot: added EVAL-4237 for quant reg checks and pushed BYOW runtime template to infra/packaging.
